name: Pointify – Interactive Hotspot
author: Nexiby LLC

sections.description: Add interactive pins/hotspots with popups to any image in Elementor.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pointify folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and active.
sections.faq:
How do I add a hotspot to an image?

Use the Pointify widget in Elementor: drag it onto your page, select an image, then click on the image to add pins. Configure each pin’s popup content in the widget settings.

Is Pointify compatible with my theme and Elementor?

Pointify works with most themes and requires Elementor (tested up to Elementor versions available at release). If your theme follows standard WordPress markup, compatibility should be fine.

Can I customize pin icons and styles?

Yes. You can select built-in pin icons and change basic styling from the widget controls. For deeper customization, add custom CSS in your theme or via Elementor’s custom CSS.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. Hotspots and popups are responsive. Popups adapt to screen size; you can further adjust behavior with custom CSS if needed.

Where can I report bugs or request new features?

Open an issue on the plugin’s support channel (or contact the plugin author). Include steps to reproduce and any relevant environment details (WordPress/PHP/Elementor versions).
